extra_quotes: We use SDMI consistently across the SNN model, its memristive SNN, and the same memristive SNN under additional hardware perturbations.
SDMI combines surrogate gradients with Expectation over Transformation (EOT) to handle discrete spiking dynamics and average over stochastic hardware and spike realizations.

Our study provides a simulation-based characterization of model-inversion susceptibility in compact memristive SNNs and does not constitute physical-chip validation or demonstrate a chip-specific fault-injection mechanism.
The quantitative results are specific to the evaluated SNN architectures, datasets, modeled ReRAM configuration, and perturbation ranges.
In addition, SSIM and PSNR quantify class-representative reconstruction fidelity and do not establish exact recovery of individual training records.
